references.text: The altar was called a witness between the tribes, confirming that the Lord is God
Continuation of the argument about the altar as a witness for future generations
The stone heap as a witness between Jacob and Laban, a similar concept of a memorial as a witness between parties
Moses' song as a witness for Israel, the theme of a lasting witness for future generations
Burnt offering before the Lord's presence at the entrance to the tent of meeting, the same expression about serving the Lord with offerings
Instructions regarding peace offerings (שְׁלָמִים), one of the three types of offerings mentioned in the verse
Command to bring burnt offerings, sacrifices, and other gifts to the place the Lord chooses
The Levites have no share in the land, but the Lord is their inheritance - a similar theme about having a share in the Lord
